solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x² + 1/x² = k, then x² − 1/x² = ±√(k² − 4).

Given k = 7, we get x² − 1/x² = ±√(7² − 4) = ±√45 = ±3√5.

Algebraic Squares

(x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2 and (x − 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² − 2.

Algebraic Cubes

x³ + 1/x³ = (x + 1/x)³ − 3(x + 1/x) and x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x − 1/x).

Fractional Range Properties

If 0 < x < 1, any positive power xⁿ is less than 1, and its reciprocal 1/xⁿ is greater than 1, making the expression xⁿ − 1/xⁿ always negative.
